snippet.title: Anvil Survivors - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Anvil Survivors is a bullet hell roguelite where you fight waves of enemies, collect loot, and upgrade your gear at the Anvil, if you dare.

The higher the risk, the greater the power. Fail the upgrade and lose everything. Succeed and become unstoppable.

Also, cats. They collect loot, they have their own abilities, and they do whatever they want. Just like real cats.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4428910/Anvil_Survivors/
